def text_view(self, title, content):
        import tkinter as tk
        from .ui_layout import scrollable_text
        from .window_placement import place_beside

        dialog = tk.Toplevel(self.root)
        dialog.title(title)
        dialog.geometry('950x650')
        text = scrollable_text(dialog, wrap='word')
        text.insert('1.0', content)
        text.configure(state='disabled')
        place_beside(dialog, self.root)
        return dialog
